subject: Redline: OmniCloud MSA + DPA (transfer addendum)
messages:
From: OmniCloud Legal <legal@omnicloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@omnicloud.com
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redline: OmniCloud MSA + DPA (transfer addendum)

Jonas —

Attached is our redline of the MSA and the proposed Data Processing Addendum with the transfer-impact addendum included. High level: we accepted most service-level items but added a carveout request on cross-border transfer liabilities that we need you to confirm.

Key asks from our side:
- Clarify controller/processor split on the Order Form (section 2).
- Customer-managed KMS for Private deployments — we marked this as "customer option" but need confirmation on Redwood's support model.
- Migration addendum language: we propose a 90-day data migration window and an operational runbook for exports.
- Audit evidence: we requested specific logs (access audit, egress routes) for SCCs compliance.

Attachments: OmniCloud_MSA_DPA_Redline_20280422.pdf (redlines), transfer-addendum-draft.docx (proposed wording).

Can we schedule a 30-minute call this week to walk through the DPA redlines and the proposed transfer addendum? Marta (procurement) will join.

Regards,
Marta Lopez
Senior Counsel, OmniCloud
OmniCloud, Inc.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: OmniCloud Legal <legal@omnicloud.com>
Cc: procurement@omnicloud.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redline: OmniCloud MSA + DPA (transfer addendum)

Marta / team —

Thanks for the redlines and the transfer-addendum draft. Quick read-through and immediate flags from product/ops (summary below). Happy to join a call; I proposed the 11:00 PT slot on Thursday in the calendar invite.

Open items we need to address before legal signoff:
1) Roles & responsibilities — we need an explicit Order Form line that lists customer data classes that OmniCloud will control vs Redwood as processor. If you can mark those classes in the Order Form that will speed review.
2) KMS approach — for Private (VPC/on-prem) we can support customer-managed keys. For Hosted we offer a managed KMS; customer-managed keys in hosted mode will require an integration plan and an additional security review (possible surcharge).
3) Transfer addendum wording — Product suggests the 90-day migration window may be operationally tight for large exports; propose "up to 120 days" and include an optional staged export.
4) Audit evidence — we can produce the log slices you requested, but need to scope retention windows. Are the requested artifacts within OmniCloud's compliance baseline?
5) Fallback routing — we need to agree on the automated fallback policy in the addendum (e.g., regional fallback vs. model variant).

Planned next steps:
- Laura (Legal) will provide markups for the DPA and a proposed migration-addendum snippet.
- Ops will produce a short note on KMS constraints for hosted vs private.
- We'll aim to resolve core DPA items on Thursday call; anything remaining will go to a short redline exchange.

Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0198

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: OmniCloud Legal <legal@omnicloud.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redline: OmniCloud MSA + DPA (transfer addendum)

Jonas — forwarding my quick legal notes after scanning OmniCloud's redline. I attached a short comments bundle (RDW_comments_dpa.docx) with inline alternative language. High-level thoughts below.

Inline proposals (high level):
- Controller/Processor: we will accept the Order Form split but need OmniCloud to list the data categories (PII, telemetry, logs, model-derivative outputs) in the Order Form schedule. I added a bracketed example in paragraph 2.
- SCCs: update to the 2024 standard references; OmniCloud's draft referenced the older template — propose we use the 2024 SCCs and include a committal to implement any future EU adequacy changes via a short amendment process.
- Migration addendum: proposed framing — "Customer may request data export; Redwood will provide export assistance for up to 120 days post-termination; export formats are CSV/NDJSON/Parquet depending on data class; tooling and runbook to be agreed in the Order Form annex." I inserted this text into transfer-addendum-draft.docx.
- KMS: for hosted we can't accept full customer-managed KMS without a separate managed-integration addendum. Proposed compromise: customers can request a "bring-your-key" evaluation; if approved, add a schedule with integration timeline and fees.
- Audit evidence & retention: propose Redwood commit to produce logs for a 90-day rolling window for egress/access; exceedance requests (longer retention) treated as a paid option.

Action items for Thursday call:
- Ben to confirm operational feasibility for 120-day migration and export formats.
- Jonas to ask OmniCloud to mark data classes in the Order Form schedule.
- I'll prepare a tracked-change redline of the DPA and a short memo for Exec should OmniCloud push back on SCCs wording.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@omnicloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@omnicloud.com, legal@omnicloud.com
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redline: OmniCloud MSA + DPA (transfer addendum)

Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the quick responses and the proposed language. We reviewed Laura's snippet and have two notes: first, OmniCloud prefers the 90-day migration window as standard for our procurement cadence; second, on KMS we cannot accept a full chargeable integration for all customers — we need a baseline option in the DPA for customer-managed keys for Private customers and an explicit "reasonable efforts" clause for hosted customers who request BYOK (bring-your-own-key) where we will evaluate feasibility.

Proposed compromise:
- Keep 90 days as the baseline migration window, but include an optional extension up to 120 days if agreed in the Order Form annex.
- KMS: add language that Customer may request BYOK; OmniCloud and Redwood will agree a technical integration timeline in the Order Form annex; if integration requires additional engineering, costs will be scoped separately.

I can accept Laura's SCCs upgrade to 2024 as long as we include a short amendment path for future adequacy changes.

I'll run the revised language by procurement and return a DocuSign-ready MSA/DPA next week. In the meantime, please send the RDW_comments_dpa.docx and the export format list from Ops.

Best,
Marta
Senior Counsel, OmniCloud
